name: human-ai-research-assistant-kit
description: AI Research Assistant workflows for discussion, explanation, research logs, decisions, tasks, references, literature surveys, presentations, collaborative paper writing under a workspace author contract (PAPER-WRITING-CONTRACT.md), and gated reviewer-feedback revision cycles.

interface.shortDescription: Research thinking, writing, and dispatch workflows.
interface.longDescription: Transform informal research into logs, decisions, implementation tasks, references, literature surveys, presentations, evidence-grounded discussions, verified manuscript revisions from reviewer feedback, and protocol-governed paper co-writing with the author.
defaultPrompt: Help me pressure-test this research idea.
Turn these notes into a research decision.
Prepare an implementation task from this decision.
Turn these reviewer comments into a gated revision roadmap.
Co-write this paper chapter with me under my writing contract.
